name: The Pond Cypress of Weizigtpark
age_estimate: roughly 125 to 135 years, from bomenbieb's planting band of 1890 to 1900

location.address: Weizigtpark, in a planting bed by the entrance, near the former coach house (Van Baerleplantsoen)

transport: About 700 m west of Dordrecht station, at the Weizigtpark entrance.
verify_notes: bomenbieb.nl: pond cypress (Taxodium ascendens, not the more common bald cypress/swamp cypress) standing in a planting bed at the park entrance, next to a building that used to serve as the estate's coach house (koetshuis, built 1886). bomenbieb calls a pond cypress of this age (~100+ years) genuinely rare in the Netherlands, which is the remarkable fact to lead with. Planting band 1890-1900, alive per source (Ja). Second source: Bomenridders Dordrecht (local tree-conservation foundation) tags this tree under 'Moerascipres' and 'Weizigtpark' on their monumental-trees page, confirming it independently. A monumentaltrees.com page for this exact tree also exists (title found via search: 'Vijvercipres in het park Weizigt, Dordrecht') and search snippets attribute a 5.03 m circumference / 25 m height to it, measured by Wim Brinkerink in 2021, but the site 403-blocked two direct fetch attempts (curl and WebFetch), so per the search-summary rule those figures are NOT verified from the primary page and are not recorded as girth_cm. Our own site already publishes dor_003 (Silver Maple) about 350 m away in the same park (matches leads file's nearest_ours_km 0.36), which independently establishes the park and its tree collection as real and already vetted by us. Sits at the entrance to Weizigtpark, same free public park as dor_003.
